purpose: Prevent a validation-season availability source result from authorizing V09B fitting before the frozen 2012-2021 training availability chronology and label semantics are independently qualified.

frozen_v09b_preregistration.model_family: expected player contribution = P(active) x expected snap share x latent value

current_evidence.validation_source_basis: Merged PR #211 qualified the 2022-2025 validation source for the specific recognized practice-participation states Full, Limited, and DNP under the frozen V3 thresholds. Strict V2 remains preserved as FAILED CLOSED; blank/unrecognized practice rows remain diagnostic and are never inferred active/healthy, and final game status remains unauthorized as a feature.
current_evidence.modern_player_team_game_identity_basis: The preregistered 2017-2021 modern Game Book identity V3 audit independently calibrated the secondary-vs-linebacker family mapping on 42,461 V1 exact-unique identities while excluding all 10 V1 ambiguity rows, then resolved both V2-retained M.Smith ambiguity rows. Final identity resolution was 137,800 / 138,205 = 0.9970695705654643 with zero ambiguity and zero source identity conflicts. This qualification is identity-only and confers no game-day membership semantics.
current_evidence.modern_game_day_roster_universe_basis: Player-team-game identity is now independently qualified for 2017-2021, but Game Book section membership semantics remain unqualified. In particular, the corrected DNP diagnostic and weekly-roster status cross-tab reject uniform DNP/ACT/INA shortcuts; no evidence currently authorizes treating Did Not Play or weekly roster status as the kickoff active/inactive denominator.
current_evidence.training_source_chronology_basis: 2012-2021 source work has advanced beyond the original legacy-feed statement, but the complete kickoff-safe training chronology required for the frozen P(active) target is not yet qualified across the full training window.
current_evidence.training_label_semantics_basis: The 2012-2021 kickoff active/inactive target denominator remains fail-closed. The 2017-2021 player-team-game identity layer is now qualified, but modern game-day roster membership semantics are not; postgame participation, weekly roster status as membership authority, source-absence inference, and retrospective inactive repair remain prohibited.

decision_rule: V09B execution is authorized only when every authorization requirement is satisfied simultaneously. The qualified 2022-2025 validation practice-state source and qualified 2017-2021 identity layer can never, individually or together, authorize fitting while training chronology or label semantics remain unqualified.
prohibited_rescues: do not infer active/healthy from source absence
do not use realized current-game snaps as a pregame feature
do not use retrospective inactive status to repair missing labels
do not use weekly-roster status as game-day membership authority
do not use later injury designations
do not use completed 2026 outcomes to design, tune, or rescue the gate
